annotations.title: Read the App Store in-app events

description: The app's In-App Events on the App Store, soonest first: ID, reference name, badge, state (DRAFT, READY_FOR_REVIEW, WAITING_FOR_REVIEW, IN_REVIEW, REJECTED, ACCEPTED, APPROVED, PUBLISHED, PAST, ARCHIVED), dates per group of territories (UTC), deep link, purchase requirement, priority, purpose, the name and descriptions per language, whether each language has its event card and details page media (and Apple's processing state), and what an editable event still needs before App Review. Also Apple's limits and allowed values. Pass eventId for one event.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

fresh.description: Ask Apple again instead of Ploa's last answer (a few minutes old at most).

name: ploa_events_get
